format: Personalized Product Preview (Your Name/Photo On It)
definition: The product shown already customized with a sample name or the buyer's photo, often with a 'name can be changed' tag or photo-to-product arrow.
why_it_works: The viewer instantly pictures their own name or pet on it, so the gift sells itself.
